note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: Here's what every major Wall Street analyst is saying about Nvidia after its earnings report
items.blurb: Analysts weigh Nvidia's first quarter without Jensen Huang: $115.8 billion in revenue and a roughly $130 billion forecast.

items.title: Nvidia's numbers and Anthropic anticipation drive Nasdaq futures up
items.blurb: Nvidia's earnings beat and Anthropic's pending IPO lifted Nasdaq futures, a test of investor appetite for AI.

items.title: Nvidia's Kress faces a divided workforce as some employees push for Huang's return
items.blurb: A petition for Huang's return has nearly 200,000 signatures; Nvidia's board says it will not reinstate him.

items.title: Behind the Curtain: Anthropic contradictions
items.blurb: Axios contrasts Anthropic's past warnings about AI risk with its pitch to investors ahead of a trillion-dollar listing.

items.title: The terrifying rise of free AI hacking tools
items.blurb: The FBI warns an AI attack framework called Artex reached privileged access in some networks in under three hours.

items.title: Cantor Fitzgerald's Nvidia business interests targeted in Democrats' Lutnick probe
items.blurb: House Democrats ask why the Commerce secretary allegedly resisted cracking down on Nvidia chips diverted to China.

items.title: Paris Hilton, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez press House to pass Defiance Act to fight AI deepfake pornography
items.blurb: The Senate-passed bill would let victims of sexually explicit AI deepfakes sue for civil damages.

items.title: LeBron James sues startup over viral AI ad allegedly exploiting his likeness
items.blurb: James says a betting startup used his name, likeness and an AI-generated voice without permission.

items.title: Anthropic considers upsizing IPO as demand surges, sources say
items.blurb: Institutional orders near $400 billion push Anthropic to weigh a price above $80; Nasdaq trading as ANT is set for Nov 19.

items.title: Retail investor enthusiasm for Anthropic IPO to rival SpaceX debut
items.blurb: Retail demand for Anthropic shares is approaching $100 billion, a scale last seen around SpaceX's listing.

items.title: Nvidia sinks after earnings, dragging down neoclouds
items.blurb: Nvidia beat revenue forecasts at $115.8 billion yet slipped about 2%, pulling down CoreWeave and other AI cloud renters.

items.title: China's military said to be seeking Nvidia's advanced chips for AI capabilities
items.blurb: A congressional commission says the PLA solicits top Nvidia chips, partly through remote access to data centers in third countries.

items.title: New U.S. chip curbs put Southeast Asia's data center boom at risk
items.blurb: Data centers in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia now need U.S. licenses to buy advanced AI chips.

items.title: Vance scraps schedule to address tech outages as Trump admin insists incidents aren't linked
items.blurb: A run of major tech outages has drawn White House attention, though officials say the incidents are not connected.

items.title: How to make AI data centres more sustainable
items.blurb: Nature's editorial weighs how the data-centre buildout can curb its energy and water footprint as AI demand grows.

items.title: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 in historic $1 trillion offering
items.blurb: Pricing above the $70 to $78 range gives Anthropic an opening market value near $1.08 trillion before Nasdaq trading.

items.title: This smell startup says its AI nose is as good as a human's
items.blurb: Osmo claims human-level smell detection on some tasks; outside experts say several of its marketing claims lack documentation.

items.title: Big bets against AI debt, from CoreWeave to Oracle and the Mag 7, could soon hit the ETF market
items.blurb: Two fund firms filed for ETFs that profit when credit risk rises at AI-linked borrowers, a sign of debt worries.

items.title: Nvidia warns chip buyers of legal risks tied to China AI access, sources tell CNBC
items.blurb: Nvidia told customers a proposed remote-access bill could expose them to US legal action over Chinese use of its chips.

items.title: Nvidia shares down slightly ahead of earnings, after days of decline
items.blurb: Nvidia reports quarterly results Nov 17, its first since Jensen Huang resigned, a key test for AI spending.

items.title: U.S. agencies detail probe on Nvidia partner Megaspeed in 2024
items.blurb: Commerce and Justice officials say they began investigating Singapore-based Megaspeed in 2024 over possible chip export violations.

items.title: Anthropic IPO: Hundreds of billions in VC bets on AI await a big public exit
items.blurb: AI firms took 86% of U.S. venture dollars in early 2026; Anthropic's debut is the first big test of an exit.

items.title: How Jensen Huang scandal makes Congress a bigger risk to U.S.-China relations
items.blurb: Economists say a Democratic Congress could tighten chip export curbs, ahead of a Trump-Xi meeting set for Nov 19.

items.title: Nvidia's earnings mark start of post-Jensen era
items.blurb: Nvidia reports third-quarter results after the close, the first under interim CEO Colette Kress after Jensen Huang's resignation.
